title: feat(plugin-chatbot): the question card takes the composer's place when the AI ends its turn on a question
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoA8HBADNrd6onRU5XaeyY7T)_

Refs #37874 (items 1-8)
Clause-②: yes (widening) — widened: `parseAskQuestionEnvelope` accepts a legacy `ask_which` reading up to 60 characters and `ASK_QUESTION_LIMITS` gains `legacyReadingMaxLength`; `ChatbotEnhancedProps` gains the optional `conversationId`; plugin-chatbot exports `QUESTION_SKIP_STORAGE_PREFIX`; `QuestionCardQuestion` / `QuestionCardOption` keep their names and are now the spec envelope types.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 控制台 AI 对话里,AI 以一个提问结束回合时,输入框的位置换成提问卡,点一个选项就作为下一条消息发出;以前用户只能看纯文字列表再自己打字。
- 属于「问 AI」专题:让 AI 的澄清提问能一键回答,也让现有的「你指的是哪个」提问(选项较长的那类)能用上卡片。
- 用户在对话里会碰到;出错时最坏是卡片不出现、回到原来的纯文字提问加输入框,草稿不会丢,回滚即恢复原样。
- 无。

## What changes

**Spec (`packages/spec/src/ai/ask-question.zod.ts`).** Per the E1 route on the card (carrier note 7219023636), a legacy `ask_which` reading has its own limit, `ASK_QUESTION_LIMITS.legacyReadingMaxLength = 60`, instead of the envelope's 24-character label, so most of today's `ask_which` questions read as a card. The option rules (no duplicate, no blank, at most one recommended) are now one `refineOptions` shared by the envelope and the legacy arm. A legacy result with an empty `reply` is refused, which makes the `reply` describe true for both arms (L2 N1 on Q1). The new `asked` envelope keeps its 24-character label.

**Wiring (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot`).**

- `chat/pendingQuestion.ts`: `findQuestions` finds every question the conversation holds (one envelope per segment between user messages, and the segment's last shown text equals its `reply`), over both shapes a tool-ended turn arrives in: one streamed message, or the tool message plus the text message of a reloaded conversation. `findPendingQuestion` adds the conditions for the card: the stream has ended, nothing streams, not read-only, no queued typed message, the question is in the last segment, not skipped, and no undecided write approval in the same segment.
- `chat/composerGate.tsx`: the composer's place, held by the card or the composer. The composer is never unmounted: it is `hidden` and `inert` while the card holds the place, so a draft, attachments and the uncontrolled textarea survive, and focus that was in it returns to it.
- `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`: one click sends the option label through `onSendMessage`. The card stays mounted while closed, so a refused send that rolls the bubble back reopens it with the choice still made. Skip writes the question's `toolCallId` under `objectstack:ai-chat-question-skip:` plus the new optional `conversationId` prop (`chat/questionSkip.ts`, every storage access in try/catch). The thread draws the question from its envelope (`chat/questionMessage.tsx`): pending shows the question alone, past shows a collapsed "AI asks: QUESTION" that expands to its options. Regenerate is hidden on a pending question; Copy still copies the full reply.
- `QuestionCard.tsx`: per the Q2a alias note, `QuestionCardQuestion` and `QuestionCardOption` keep their exported names and are aliased to `AskQuestionParsed` / `AskQuestionOptionParsed`; long labels wrap.

**Console (`ui/packages/app-shell`).** `ChatPane` passes its conversation id, and `purgeChatCaches` clears the skip prefix on sign-out with the rest of the chat cache.

**Checklist and docs.** One platform-checklist item, `ai.chat-question-card`. The plugin-chatbot docs page and the package README gain a paragraph on the card. The README is outside the claimed file surface (reported to the seat). Regenerated: the `ask-question` spec reference and the strictness-ledger AI counts.

Files to read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/chat/pendingQuestion.ts`: the segment rule and the pending conditions decide when the card replaces the composer.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`: the `answeredQuestion` state that keeps the card after a send, and the gate around `PromptInput`.
3. `packages/spec/src/ai/ask-question.zod.ts`: the legacy arm and its 60-character limit.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ai/ask-question.test.ts`: the legacy limit at 60 and 61 characters, the envelope still at 24, trimmed duplicates, blank reading, long question, empty reply.
- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/pendingQuestion-37874.test.ts`: both turn shapes, the envelope and the legacy result, and every condition that holds the card back (streaming, other final text, a later message, two questions in one batch, a user or HITL message after it, a queued message, an undecided approval, a skip, read-only, a failed tool).
- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.questionCard-37874.test.tsx`: through the rendered component, the gate (composer mounted, hidden, inert), a draft surviving the card and a skip, a one-click answer, a refused send reopening the card with the choice made, a queued message winning over the card, read-only, skip persistence per conversation, the pending and past message, Regenerate hidden and Copy kept.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useChatConversation.test.tsx`: sign-out clears the skip key.

## Acceptance notes

- Items 1-8 land here. Item 9 (the brightrule smoke after release) is the maintainer's, so this PR refers to the card and does not close it; the seat's `Release:` on landing names what is left.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/ChatPane.tsx` is also touched by #37970 (one added prop here). Whichever lands second merges main before queueing.
- No new i18n keys: the card reuses `chatbot.questionCard.*`, so no locale pack is touched.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.questionCard-37874.test.tsx`, expect 16 passing tests.

## Verification

Head `19d67fd4b3`, branched from `57ab08760c` (origin/main).

- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --ran` reports 113 derived, 113 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, every line with its exit code, all exit 0. Two gates first answered exit 3 (prerequisite not built: `check:skill-examples` wanted `client-react` dist, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` wanted built packages); after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client-react build` and the battery's own package build, both re-ran under the verify lock and exited 0.
- Unit: spec `ask-question.test.ts` 19/19; UI vitest over plugin-chatbot, the app-shell `useChatConversation` test and `console/ai`: 111 files, 1006 tests passed.
- Type-check and build: plugin-chatbot type-check and build, app-shell type-check, exit 0. `check:generated` clean after `--fix` regenerated the two spec artifacts.
- Overlap: `overlap-check --pr=37970` VERDICT clean; the one shared file is `ChatPane.tsx`.

<details><summary>Ablations (one-off, restored; `git diff HEAD` empty after each)</summary>

- `pendingQuestion.ts`: drop the `queued` condition. 2 tests turn red (the unit "typed message is queued" case and the component "message queued during the turn" case), 31 pass.
- `composerGate.tsx`: `inert={held}` to `inert={false}`. 1 test turns red (the composer is no longer inert), 15 pass.
- `ask-question.zod.ts`: a legacy reading held to the 24-character label instead of 60. 1 test turns red ("holds a reading to its own limit"), 18 pass.

</details>
